_schema_note: Mirrors the LE10/LE11 convergence_study schema. Per-rung `within_case_tolerance` is computed against the 1.0% agreement band. UNLIKE LE3/FV52, the residual here CLOSES toward zero with refinement (a true discretisation residual, not a formulation gap).
_trend_monotone_note: sigma_theta(a) decreases monotonically toward the analytic 65.312 MPa as the mesh refines; the residual closes +0.43% -> -0.01% (nr 20 -> 80). Refinement REDUCES the residual to zero, confirming a genuine continuum (plane-stress) elasticity agreement (no reduced-kinematic plate/shell-theory gap).
notes: Rotating annular disk (a=0.2 m, b=1.0 m, thin), steel E=200 GPa nu=0.3 rho=7850, omega=100 rad/s, ccx 2.23 *DLOAD CENTRIF, C3D20 quarter model with z=0 mid-plane symmetry (plane-stress state). Headline = hoop stress sigma_theta at the inner bore r=a, target 65.312 MPa (Timoshenko & Goodier plane-stress closed form). Canonical nr=48 rung observed 65.3533 MPa, +0.063%. The sigma_theta(r)/sigma_r(r) profile ALONG THE +x RADIAL LINE (see profile_crosscheck; one radial line at the top surface, not a circumferential or through-thickness sweep) matches the analytic field to within +/-0.1%, and sigma_r(a)=0.109 MPa ~ 0 confirms the free inner-edge boundary.

profile_crosscheck.description: sigma_theta(r) and sigma_r(r) along the +x radial line (top surface) at nr=64 vs the Timoshenko closed form (MPa). Sampled points along this one radial line show |error| <= 0.1%; this is a radial-line profile, not a circumferential or through-thickness sweep.
